context: 44 Lab / Fortyfour Lab custom-rug project: hand-drawn devil logo by Pau. The two source PNGs are NOT identical: "devil 2.png" = devil only; "12.png" = the same devil (pixel-identical) + the curved "44 LAB" lettering. 1,847,280 pixels differ, all inside x2047-6286, y1043-2394 (the lettering).
palette_note: flat vector art, only ~1100 unique colours in 69 Mpx (rest = antialiasing). The lettering uses its own slightly brighter yellow and a blue-black outline, different from the devil (#edb52b / #2d2d2d).
keying_method: every boundary between art and tan is a dark outline with an exact linear antialias mix (residual <= 2/255), so alpha was solved per pixel at full 8334px resolution against the tan (0 fringe pixels unexplained), colour set to the pure outline colour, then alpha/premultiplied colour averaged over 3x3 blocks
background_note: the dark outline (#2d2d2d) disappears on near-black backgrounds (cream highlight line + fills still read); best on cream/tan/white/colour. Enclosed tan areas (between trident prongs, inside A/B counters) are transparent.
